summaries.n-binance-hack-coins: Coins named for Binance's hack and its SAFU insurance fund. SAFU Fund (SAFU, Flap, 0x7c907d...): "Taxes going to SAFU wallet for helping Binance to buyback tokens with USDC." SAFU Fund (SAFU, Flap, 0x9897ad...): "SAFU Fund". Funds Are Safu (SAFU, Flap, 0xdd806e...) has no description; its name quotes the phrase. The $19 Freeze ($19, Pump.fun): "Starknet Foundation froze 428 STRK $0.0442 ($19) which were stolen on Binance." Binance's own X account posted a service update on 2026-10-30 04:36 UTC saying deposits are unaffected and withdrawals remain paused for a security revamp, with a resumption expected within 48 hours (e3:0). Nikkei Asia (10:00 UTC) and Indian Express (05:32 UTC) posts report a $6.3bn hack and about $3 billion frozen, and Binance's founder posted "Your funds are SAFU!" at 11:57 UTC (e3:0, e3:1); the figures are as reported in those posts and are not verified here. Pools opened on 2026-10-30 (the two SAFU Fund coins and The $19 Freeze, 1 to 5 hours before discovery) and 2026-10-10 (Funds Are Safu, before the hack). The coins borrow Binance's name or its SAFU phrase; none is shown to be connected to Binance, and the SAFU Fund tax claim is the coin's own.
summaries.n-zcash-launchpads: Solana coins built around Zcash. SNARKS Launchpad (SNARKS, Meteora DBC): "Official Snarks Launchpad coin, every trade pays a 1% fee in ZEC and 60% of it goes to holders every 48 hours." Sapling (SAPLING, Pump.fun): "the rootstock of SAPLING, the zcash launchpad on solana. 0.50% of every trade on every coin buys $SAPLING and burns it." Anonymous Cat (ZCAT, StonkFun): "The Cat Stays Anonymous. No Socials. Zcash Rewards." (added 2026-10-30; pool opened 2026-09-06). Zcash Shielded Assets (Stamp, Pump.fun) has no description; its name is the story, and a Moonshot post of 2026-09-20 calls it verified there. BSC News (2026-10-29 05:50 UTC) said Zcash turned 10 on 2026-10-28; Snarks Pad posted "Happy birthday @Zcash $SNARKS" the same evening and sapling.cash posted on 2026-10-29 01:04 UTC that its launches now run on Raydium LaunchLab. Pools opened on 2026-09-06 (ZCAT), 2026-09-20 (Stamp), 2026-09-25 (SAPLING) and 2026-10-11 (SNARKS). Fee, payout, reward and burn claims are the projects' own and are not verified here; SAPLING was in an earlier narrative that was retired on 2026-10-03 at the cap.
